posts.t:
Kaprizov (illness) and Hughes (rest day) did not practice today.

M. Foligno and Spurgeon skated with the team. Hynes doesn't anticipate them playing tomorrow. 

N. Foligno is skating on his own. 

Sturm is doing well.

Wallstedt in net tomorrow. No lineup changes expected.
